title: antennaria neglecta var. athabascensis
intro: Antennaria neglecta var. athabascensis, commonly known as Mountain Silvermoss, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Asteraceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Silvermoss include wound healing, skin protection, and the treatment of various infections. The bioactive constituents of Mountain Silvermoss include sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
